mapper.sql: id, node_group_id, agent_id, node_name, ip_address, status, agent_version, os_info, cpu_info, gpu_info, total_memory, total_disk, labels, running_tasks, last_heartbeat_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM compute_node WHERE status = 'online' ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compute_node (node_group_id, agent_id, node_name, ip_address, status, agent_version, os_info, cpu_info, gpu_info, total_memory, total_disk, labels, running_tasks, last_heartbeat_at) VALUES (#{nodeGroupId}, #{agentId}, #{nodeName}, #{ipAddress}, COALESCE(#{status},'online'), #{agentVersion}, #{osInfo}, #{cpuInfo}::jsonbNULL, #{gpuInfo}::jsonbNULL, #{totalMemory}, #{totalDisk}, #{labels}::jsonb'{}'::jsonb, COALESCE(#{runningTasks},0), #{lastHeartbeatAt}) ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO UPDATE SET node_name = EXCLUDED.node_name, ip_address = EXCLUDED.ip_address, status = EXCLUDED.status, agent_version = EXCLUDED.agent_version, os_info = EXCLUDED.os_info, cpu_info = EXCLUDED.cpu_info, gpu_info = EXCLUDED.gpu_info, total_memory = EXCLUDED.total_memory, total_disk = EXCLUDED.total_disk, labels = EXCLUDED.labels, last_heartbeat_at= EXCLUDED.last_heartbeat_at, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE compute_node SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE compute_node SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
UPDATE compute_node SET labels = #{labels}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE compute_node SET node_group_id = #{nodeGroupId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE compute_node SET last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, status = 'online', running_tasks = COALESCE(#{runningTasks}, running_tasks), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE compute_node SET running_tasks = COALESCE(#{runningTasks},0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM compute_node WHERE status = 'online' AND (last_heartbeat_at IS NULL OR last_heartbeat_at < #{cutoff})
